---
title: "Localization drift"
---

The canonical page declares REQ-001 as an approved high-priority
requirement. Its Portuguese sibling is supposed to be the same object in
another language -- the translation below quietly changed the status, which
is how a second, competing engineering model starts.

::: {.need #REQ-001 type="functional-requirement" status="approved" priority="high"}
## Authenticate administrators

The service shall authenticate administrators before granting access.

### Rationale

Privileged access demands a verified identity.
:::
